home.title: Welcome to Ibiza
home.desc: Pick a DJ and the party starts. Every genre, every vibe, one tap.

decks.title: Two decks. One AI DJ.
decks.desc: Real turntables spin, the mixer moves, keys match. The AI DJ mixes live in front of you.

djmenu.title: Switch DJs in a swipe
djmenu.desc: Pop, Afrobeats, Amapiano, Hip-hop and more. Each DJ has its own crate and voice.

sara.title: DJ Sara, Habesha nights
sara.desc: Ethiopian hits mixed by DJ Sara, who speaks in her own voice.

loves.title: Send love to the song
loves.desc: Tap the heart and the screen floats with love. Your taste trains the DJ.

reactions.title: React like you're in the crowd
reactions.desc: 🔥 😂 👍 go full screen, like a real dance floor.

bell.title: Your activity bell
bell.desc: Loves, shares and new drops in one clean list.

christmas.title: Christmas DJ
christmas.desc: 2,000+ holiday songs, snow falling and a surprise from Santa.

aiblends.title: 22 AI blends
aiblends.desc: Two songs, one new track. Ibiza's AI blends them live in Blend Studio.

kids.title: Kids DJ Sparkles
kids.desc: Safe, clean, happy songs for little ones. No data collected.

upnext.title: See what's up next
upnext.desc: The queue the AI DJ is building for you, song by song.

mydj.title: My DJ: you on the decks
mydj.desc: Pro decks in your pocket. Take over from the AI any time.

gallery.title: The Ibiza gallery
gallery.desc: Hundreds of party photos that move with the music.

artists.title: 585 artist stories
artists.desc: Bios for the stars behind every song.

enter.title: Plan your Ibiza trip
enter.desc: Clubs, beaches and nights out, all in one trip planner.

brain.title: The AI brain
brain.desc: The agent swarm that keeps making every DJ smarter.

cx-sunset.title: Sunset Drop
cx-sunset.desc: The biggest drop of the night lands on the exact minute the sun sets where you are.

cx-party.title: Party Room
cx-party.desc: Friends scan a QR code, vote the next song and push the crossfader together.

cx-crowdcam.title: Crowd Cam
cx-crowdcam.desc: The camera reads the dance floor on your phone, and the DJ speeds up when people move.

cx-dedicate.title: Dedications
cx-dedicate.desc: The DJ gives your friend a shout-out on air, and they get a ping.

cx-battle.title: DJ Battle
cx-battle.desc: Two AI DJs go head to head. The crowd votes the winner.

cx-hum.title: Hum it in
cx-hum.desc: Hum a tune and the DJ finds it and drops it next.

cx-reel.title: Your Night reel
cx-reel.desc: A 15-second video of your set, ready to post when the music stops.

cx-stems.title: Live stems
cx-stems.desc: Mute the vocals, solo the drums, flip the bass. Pull any song apart live.
